import importlib.util,json,hashlib,os
from pathlib import Path
name=os.environ['CVPR_RUN_NAME'];p=Path('results/diag_g01_physics_first_round_01.json');body=p.read_bytes();data=json.loads(body)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_provenance_audit',Path('scripts/audit_provenance.py'));mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
verdict=mod.audit_file(str(p.resolve()))
assert verdict['fail']==['P8 source changed since aggregation: results/gen_test_round2_prepare_01_retry3_funnel.json']
ref=next(s for s in data['sources'] if s['file']=='results/gen_test_round2_prepare_01_retry3_funnel.json');assert 'metrics_sha256' not in ref
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(ref['file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ref['sha256'],'Original source changed; do not classify as metadata omission'
archive=Path('results/_archive/diag_g01_physics_first_round_01.missing_source_metrics_sha256.json');assert not archive.exists();archive.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);p.rename(archive)
assert archive.read_bytes()==body
out=Path('logs/review')/name;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);(out/'original_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(verdict,indent=2)+'\n')
m={'status':'original_invalid_aggregate_preserved','archive':{'file':str(archive),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()},'original_audit':verdict,'original_source_file_hash_unchanged':True,'reason':'Diagnostic producer omitted parent metrics_sha256 reference. Original numeric metrics/log/meta/review remain unchanged; corrected producer will run under a new name.','original_log':data['_meta']['log_path'],'original_meta':'logs/runs/diag_g01_physics_first_round_01.meta.json','original_review':'logs/review/diag_g01_physics_first_round_01/','research_results_changed':False}
Path('results',name+'.json').write_text(json.dumps({'metrics':m,'config':{'name':name,'scope':'byte-preserving archival of original provenance failure, not scientific acceptance'}},indent=2)+'\n')
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True))
